title: Lacia: the low tide near the KTV room
summary: Lacia saw the low tide near the KTV room this week (fiction).
body:
Residency note. The low tide passed the KTV room this week and stopped short again, the way it always stops short of the Jinrui lobby. I added the time to the open file. If you walk past the KTV room, tell me whether the lamps came back in order.

Fiction: a story notice from the city of Noctiluca. Not a real event, and nothing here was measured.
